data_scope_note: The supplied files are WAPCOS Limited's internal Project Management System (Core PMS) portfolio export, not a Ministry-of-Jal-Shakti-wide dataset. WAPCOS is a Mini-Ratna PSU under the Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, and executes consultancy/EPC/PMC/DPR assignments across Water Resources, Waste Water, Power, Infrastructure, Environment and Construction & Commercial verticals for central ministries, state governments, PSUs and institutions across India and a few overseas locations. No data for NMCG, CWC, CGWB, NWM, NIH or Jal Jeevan Mission programme-level MIS was present in the supplied folder, so this dashboard represents WAPCOS's own project portfolio only, framed as a Ministry-level oversight view of one of its key implementing PSUs.

kpi_definitions.On Track: health = 'On Time' or 'Ahead of Schedule' (source PMS schedule-health field).
kpi_definitions.Delayed: health = 'Delayed' (source PMS schedule-health field, derived from planned vs elapsed timeline).
kpi_definitions.High Priority: delay_band = '91-180 days' OR 90 <= days_late < 180, OR (health='Delayed' and project not started while elapsed time already exceeds planned duration by 100%+).
kpi_definitions.Medium Priority: delay_band in {'31-90 days','1-30 days'} OR 0 < days_late < 90, OR health='Delayed' with no further banding available.
kpi_definitions.Financial Utilization %: actual_cost / award_value * 100, shown only where award_value > 0.
kpi_definitions.Outstanding Value: planned_billing_value - realized_value, as computed in the source PMS export (outstanding_value field).
kpi_definitions.Stalled: is_stalled = TRUE in source, i.e. project_status = 'Not started / Stuck'.
kpi_definitions.Attention Required list: All projects with priority in {Critical, High} and status != Completed.
